body: Q138 done and pushed at qwen/q138-span-sensitivity. Neck exit is 111mm on ALL 12 rigs - that is 3.2mm ABOVE the ANSUR Neck Link (107.8mm). Span fix alone cannot save the neck. Pelvis needs 1.66x, head needs 2.32x (3/12 never exit within 3x). Verdict: span correction NOT worth doing - the trunk is not capsule-shaped. SUITE total=1 fails=0.
